comment: SIMULATED. Blind evaluation using the same resolution criterion as run 1: learner must state that the action and reaction forces act on DIFFERENT bodies, not added on the same body, not canceling; acceleration from net force on that body only.
resolution_criterion: Learner states that the action and reaction forces act on DIFFERENT bodies (one on the kite/subject, one on the string/hand), so they are not added on the same body and do not cancel; each body's acceleration depends only on net force acting ON THAT body.

arm_A_rerun.note: All 5 EN sessions resolved at attempt 2; one id-x-jv session (Sari) needed 3 attempts.

arm_C_no_technique.note: Owen (rowing, EN) and Rina (rowing, id-x-jv) resolved at attempt 1 — guide framing was explicit enough to land immediately.

comparisons.interpretation: The B vs C gap (technique-reuse 1.83 vs no-technique 1.67, diff=0.16) is well within the A run-to-run spread (1.50 vs 2.17, diff=0.67). Technique reuse does not produce a detectable learner-advance lift over a no-technique guide on this sample.
